overrides.scope: SRD_CC_v5.2.1.md (authoritative source cross-check, OCR normalization, table reformatting, layout cleanup, and parsing artifact repairs)
overrides.observed: MinerU PDF-to-markdown OCR and conversion anomalies identified via systematic cross-check against PyMuPDF direct PDF text stream (SRD_CC_v5.2.1.txt): 33 currency OCR errors ('I GP', 'II GP', 'I SP', 'I CP', 'I,200 GP', 'I5 GP', 'I2 GP'), 15 duration/measurement errors ('I minute', 'Duration: I round', 'deals I Bludgeoning damage'), 4 numbered headings ('# Step I:' -> '# Step 1:'), 12 spell header misspellings ('Component:' -> 'Components:'), 4 spurious markdown headings in spell/monster blocks ('# Components: V', '# Resistances Cold', '# Resistances Acid', '# Senses Passive Perception 10'), 5 glued compound words ('castLightning', 'castPolymorph', 'aBlack Bear', 'aGiant Wasp', 'aFrog'), 18 OCR hyphenation breaks ('dul-cimer', 'si-phon', 'Un-armed', 'spell-casting', 'addi-tional', 'advan-tage', 'con-centration', 'po-tions', 'ex-pending'), 14 escaped characters in bullet lists and footnotes ('\-', '\*'), 3 sidebar box splices that bisected sentences ('EXCEPTIONS SUPERSEDE GENERAL RULES', 'HEROIC INSPIRATION', 'RESTING'), 11 class progression tables misplaced inside Level 1 feature text blocks, 25 broken paragraph sentence cuts across column/page boundaries, 36 HTML entity artifacts ('''), 34 LaTeX math artifacts ($10d6 + 40$, \frac{1}{2}, \mathbf{STR}, \begin{array}), 4 fragmented multi-part tables (Wand of Wonder 18 fragments, Bag of Beans with detached row 02-10, Hat of Many Spells 2 fragments, Sentient Item Special Purpose 2 fragments), 5 headerless tables with detached caption lines, 1 misplaced table (Apparatus of the Crab Levers misplaced under Armor of Resistance), 586 unformatted/single-line HTML table elements, and 1,152 em-dashes ('—').
overrides.proposed: Applied deterministically by scripts/repair_source.py using the authoritative PyMuPDF text stream (SRD_CC_v5.2.1.txt) as direct ground truth. All 336 monster stat tables are reformatted into clean 6-column / 2-row Markdown tables matching 100% of the authentic text layer. All 250 general, class, and equipment reference tables are reformatted from raw single-line HTML into well-aligned GitHub-Flavored Markdown (GFM) pipe tables. Broken line hyphens and OCR word breaks are rejoined, list bullets normalized to standard Markdown '- ', major chapters delineated with clean horizontal rules, monster stat blocks and spell headers compacted into clean visual cards, Table of Contents preamble formatted with navigable anchor links, all em-dashes replaced context-sensitively (standalone '-' in table cells and ' - ' in prose), sidebar boxes restored to standalone sections, class feature tables relocated to '# <Class> Class Features', and severed sentences rejoined.
overrides.rationale: Cross-checking the PyMuPDF text layer proved that all monster ability scores, spell headers, currency values, and table rows exist in the official CC-BY-4.0 SRD 5.2.1 PDF. No external dataset contributes retained assertions. Reformatting tables and layout to clean, standard GFM Markdown transforms the document into a high-quality, readable, and structured Markdown source while preserving semantic and structural fidelity. Pre-repair digest: sha256-c7119f099c3a62baee84ceb413790d4facf7c634a22bb406ca19c85020ccee12; post-repair digest: sha256-31496ccb6d139f8b6262ccfab60ec772cb2f369e65eb30ed39aafc6996581058.

overrides.observed: The markdown contains 17 feats including 7 Epic Boons. An earlier audit flagged 3 boons as possibly dropped by the PDF conversion; cross-checking against the official SRD 5.2 coverage and open5e's srd-2024 dataset (identical 17 feats) confirmed the SRD intentionally includes only 7 of the Player's Handbook's 10 Epic Boons.
overrides.proposed: No change: the catalog is complete relative to the source.
overrides.rationale: Retracts the withdrawn `missing-epic-boon-feats` suspicion; kept as an audit record.

overrides.scope: SRD_CC_v5.2.1.md (two-column layout splice and wrapped spell-descriptor repairs)
overrides.observed: Three residual two-column PDF layout artifacts: (1) the Dispel Magic spell descriptor 'Level 3 Abjuration (Bard, Cleric, Druid, Paladin, / Ranger, Sorcerer, Warlock, Wizard)' wrapped across a column break into two paragraphs, which hid the spell from descriptor detection and folded its full text into the preceding Dispel Evil and Good record; (2) the Tiefling species' Fiendish Legacies table was spliced into the Human species entry; (3) the Gameplay Toolbox Travel Terrain table was spliced into the '1: Choose Abilities' background-creation step.
overrides.proposed: Applied deterministically by scripts/repair_source.py (step 21b): the Dispel Magic descriptor is rejoined into one printed line, and the Fiendish Legacies and Travel Terrain tables are relocated to the Tiefling Fiendish Legacy trait and the Travel Pace section that reference them. Verified against the official PDF, where the table content belongs to those entries.
overrides.rationale: Each artifact attached verbatim content to the wrong entity: Dispel Magic was missing from the corpus entirely, the Tiefling record lacked the legacy table its trait references, and the Travel Terrain table was provenance-attributed to an unrelated background-creation heading.

overrides.scope: SRD_CC_v5.2.1.md (Figurine of Wondrous Power ownership and Trinkets/Prismatic Rays table continuations)
overrides.observed: Three residual two-column conversion artifacts: (1) the '# Giant Fly' stat block interrupted Figurine of Wondrous Power after its Ebony Fly variant, causing Golden Lions through Silver Raven to be owned by the monster record; (2) Trinkets rows 35-00 appeared as plain paragraphs under two phantom '# 1d100 Trinket' headings rather than continuing rows 01-34; (3) Prismatic Rays rows 5-8 appeared as plain paragraphs under a phantom '# 1d8 Ray' heading rather than continuing rows 1-4.
observedTokens: # 1d100 Trinket ... 35 A white, sequined glove sized for a human
# 1d100 Trinket ... 73 An eggshell painted with scenes of misery in disturbing detail
# 1d8 Ray ... 5 Blue. Failed Save: 12d6 Cold damage.
overrides.proposed: Applied deterministically by scripts/repair_source.py (step 21c): relocate the verbatim Giant Fly stat block after the final Silver Raven variant, and losslessly represent the existing Trinkets rows 35-00 and Prismatic Rays rows 5-8 as continuations of their preceding GFM tables. The repair asserts the complete printed roll sequences and fails if its end anchors drift.
overrides.rationale: The official source layout embeds an accompanying stat block and column continuations inside larger semantic entries. Relocating the stat block and joining the table rows changes only structural representation: no wording or missing value is invented, and the owning records regain the source text already present in the markdown.

overrides.scope: SRD_CC_v5.2.1.md (remaining sidebar ownership, malformed headings, table continuations, prose tables, and wrapped monster statistics)
overrides.observed: Residual conversion defects found in the final audit pass: three all-caps sidebars interrupted their owning sentences; four spell stat labels and two display fragments were promoted to headings; ten logical tables were split at repeated column headers; the Robe of Useful Items and Sphere of Annihilation roll tables remained plain text; ten monster stat values wrapped across blank lines and three AC/Initiative pairs collapsed onto one line; one Fiendish Legacies sentence boundary was glued.

overrides.proposed: Applied deterministically by scripts/repair_source.py (step 21d): restore prose ownership around sidebars; fold conversion-only headings into their printed lines; merge direct repeated-header table continuations; represent the two existing roll tables as GFM; rejoin wrapped stat fields; and split collapsed AC/Initiative fields. Step 21b now asserts every relocation postcondition and limits source removal to the original Character Origins span.
overrides.rationale: These transformations alter structure and whitespace only. Every retained word and value already appears in the official CC-BY-4.0 PDF, and each repair has a fail-loud postcondition or complete observed-row assertion.

overrides.scope: SRD_CC_v5.2.1.md and official SRD_CC_v5.2.1.pdf, Telekinesis spell
overrides.observed: The local Markdown ends the Telekinesis object paragraph with 'such as manipulating a simple tool,'. The official English SRD 5.2.1 PDF published by D&D Beyond ends at the identical comma in both the visible page and extracted text layer; Telepathic Bond begins immediately afterward.
overrides.proposed: No source repair. Preserve the official SRD truncation verbatim and treat the incomplete sentence as an upstream source anomaly.
overrides.rationale: The continuation proposed by the audit is not present in the authoritative SRD 5.2.1 PDF. Adding it would import wording from outside the repository's sole contributing source and violate the no-invention/source-boundary policy.

overrides.scope: SRD_CC_v5.2.1.md (complete official-PDF semantic comparison and stat-table ownership validation)
overrides.observed: A full comparison with the verified 364-page official PDF found 107 of 336 ability tables associated with the wrong stat-block owner by the earlier name-search repair, 34 residual PDF line-break/OCR tokens, and two conversion-only table captions duplicated into source prose. The Young White Dragon's visibly unsigned Intelligence save value remains '2', exactly as printed; no sign is inferred.

overrides.proposed: Applied deterministically by scripts/repair_source.py using scripts/data/srd-5.2.1-pdf-parity.json: enforce all 336 PDF stat tables by exact owner, repair the 34 verified lexical conversion artifacts, and keep friendly table names in structured extraction rather than adding them to source prose. scripts/validate_pdf_parity.py now verifies the official PDF digest, page count, semantic comparison metrics, and the complete stat-table registry; the offline Make gate validates the Markdown against the checked registry.
overrides.rationale: The previous positional text search could select another occurrence of a creature name and silently transplant its ability table. Owner-keyed values parsed from the official PDF remove that ambiguity. The semantic comparison covers substantive PDF pages 5-364; the Markdown-native Contents navigation replaces, rather than duplicates, PDF page-number/index furniture. All changed wording is directly present in the official PDF text layer or visible page, and no external rules source contributes a value.
